comments.author: @AversusB
comments.text: H3 will help. But make sure you get one that has weight inside that shake around. Not a solid buffer at H3 weight. H3 will have some tungsten in it and you have noticed that tungsten is $$$ right now. You could also look at getting a +power Sprinco spring. I run Atrius FRS on a few of my builds. 22lr with FRS is a giggle switch and not super spendy on ammo. For 5.56 I start with a Spikes Tactical T3 buffer. It's filled with tungsten powder vs. weights. BTW...it's funny how our journey's are similar. From drones to guns.
